candidate.definition_en: Relating to the Middle Ages (roughly 500–1500 AD).
candidate.explanation_ar: متعلق بالعصور الوسطى في تاريخ أوروبا (زمن القلاع والفرسان).

senses.definition_en: Connected with or belonging to the Middle Ages (the historical period from roughly 500 to 1500 CE).
examples: We spent the afternoon exploring a medieval castle on the hill.
The museum features an impressive collection of medieval art.

senses.definition_ar: قديم جداً، متخلف، أو قاسٍ بشكل مبالغ فيه (استخدام مجازي).
examples: The plumbing in this old building is positively medieval.
We visited a medieval town in France.
The museum has a collection of medieval art.
Historians still debate the daily life of peasants in medieval Europe.
candidate.mnemonic: فيها 'Mid' يعني وسط.. 'Medieval' يعني العصور الوسطى (Middle Ages).
